bed_size_mm.note: Advertised printable XYZ, not guaranteed usable export bounds.

nozzle_diameter_mm.note: Standard included nozzle; optional sizes excluded.

max_nozzle_temperature_c.note: Manufacturer capability, not a filament preset.

multi_color_system.note: Compatible optional/combo accessory, not necessarily included.

native_file_formats.note: Sliced-plate export for Farm Manager; not editable generic 3MF or every transfer method.

official_slicer_download_url.note: Official download landing page, not a platform-specific binary.

optional_units.note: AMS lite is one unit and cannot be combined with AMS, AMS 2 Pro, or AMS HT. The A1 AMS hub connects up to four of those.

firmware.note: Bambu Lab's own firmware. The M400 U1 pause is what Bambu Studio inserts; not stated on the cited spec page.

notes: Reviewed 2026-10-12. Manufacturer references; no hardware/export validation.
Maximum bed temperature omitted pending verification. Missing fields mean unknown, not zero.
